title: A Locally Conservative Enriched Linearized Neural Network Approximation to Elliptic PDEs
summary: This paper presents a locally conservative Enriched Linearized Neural Network (ENN) method for the Darcy flow model. A linearized shallow ReLU$^k$ network, whose hidden-layer parameters are fixed on a quasi-uniform set of the sphere, carries the approximation, and piecewise constant functions on an auxiliary subdivision of the domain are added to ensure local mass conservation. The subdivision may consist of general, possibly curved, elements.
